event.description: Runway 27L closed: disabled aircraft on runway, tow requested

atc.notes: TWR/APP NOTE 1650L: RWY 27L CLSD - disabled acft on rwy, tow requested. Field est reopen ~1750L but tow crew says 'maybe 1800+'. West flow, 26R only rwy for arrivals, 28 deps only. DL811 HVY seq 26R 1721L. Sector saturated, AAR cut to 30/hr.

pilot.notes: DISPATCH/ACARS 1655L DL912 N927DA MD88: FOB EST AT ATL ETA 4200KG. MIN LDG FUEL 3300KG (ALTN BHM + 30MIN FINAL RES). HOLD BURN APPROX 45KG/MIN. PAX: 9 CNX TO DL72 ATL-AMS 1845L LAST AMS TODAY, INTL MCT 60MIN. 22 DOM CNX. ACFT NEXT LEG DL2289 AVL STD 1754L.

ground.notes: RAMP CTRL A-CONC 1652L: A17 occupied by delayed outbound, est push 1750-1755. A15 occupied until ~1740. A19 jetbridge fault, tech ETA 1830. A21 open. Team 3 (A15-A19) shift ends 1800, no OT authorised (2/5 at cap). Team 4 (A21-A23) on until 2200. Tug A-1 hyd leak OOS until 1830, A-2 avail.
